title: pre-existing suite cannot compile: schema_validation.rs passes serde_yaml::Value into mdatron-core's serde_yaml_ng API

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLASSIFICATION (the symmetric duty, recorded at filing before the fix): fix-lane increment entry — the defect lives in pre-existing test code (vsdd-core/tests/schema_validation.rs), outside Layer 1's build scope. Form: BROKEN VERIFICATION SURFACE — the workspace suite cannot compile, so no pin test is expressible; the recorded failing state IS the red evidence per the contract's lawful bootstrap path: cargo test --workspace fails at compile with ten E0308 mismatches, serde_yaml::Value vs serde_yaml_ng::Value, at schema_validation.rs lines including 34/45/56/67/78/89/100/124/138 against mdatron-core schema.rs:52 validate(&YamlValue). Root cause: the mdatron path dependency moved its YAML type to serde_yaml_ng; this consumer's tests were not swept. DISCOVERED at the Layer 1 red-gate authoring's first suite run — which also falsifies the adopted seed's zero-pre-existing-failures baseline claim: the truthful baseline is suite-cannot-compile, corrected here per the provenance discipline. Split side: attended act ends at this filing; the fix follows immediately (bootstrap hand-carry; validator: quality-engineer at the terminal re-verify). Fix shape: the test file adopts serde_yaml_ng 0.10 as a dev-dependency matching the consumed API; no behavior change, compile restoration only.

comments.author: xqjG

Gate posture per the broken-verification-surface form: the recorded failing state above is the red evidence; the restored green run is on the #716 red-run record (31 pre-existing tests green). Bootstrap hand-carry; validator quality-engineer re-verifies at the layer's terminal check.
